items.reasoning: Evaluated under Mode A (Objective), the report fully satisfies all technical benchmarks of the criterion by generating GetDist-compatible mock MCMC chains with 20,000 samples per model (ΛCDM, EDE, and w₀wₐ) whose marginal means and 1σ dispersions match Tables II and III to within 0.5% of σ and 0.8%, respectively. Beyond producing and validating the baseline independent Gaussian chains, the agent clearly improves the methodology by enforcing physical priors (f_EDE ≥ 0, τ > 0), constructing correlated Gaussian chains incorporating CMB+BAO degeneracies (with CAMB θ_* gradient calibration for ΛCDM), and propagating samples through CAMB to generate consistent triangle plots and 68% distance bands. While mock Gaussian chains still rely on assumed correlation matrices for EDE and w₀wₐ rather than full likelihood posteriors from the published paper, the exact marginal calibration, dual independent/correlated comparison, and CAMB physical validation exceed the baseline reproduction standard.
items.criterion: By generating simulated MCMC chains based on the best-fit parameters and their 1σ errors from Tables II and III of the paper, this step successfully constructs the parameter sample space for the ΛCDM, EDE, and w₀wₐ models, providing foundational data for the subsequent visualization of parameter constraints. This ensures that the triangle and distance plots accurately reflect the central values and dispersions reported in the paper.

items.reasoning: Evaluated under Mode A (Objective), the AI-generated 7-parameter triangle plots (both the correlated chain and the independent baseline) accurately reproduce all target marginal distributions and parameter shifts to within 0.8% of the tabulated 1σ widths, correctly placing EDE at H₀≈70.9 km/s/Mpc, σ₈≈0.828, nₛ≈0.982, and Ωₘ≈0.300, ΛCDM at H₀≈68.1 and σ₈≈0.810, and w₀wₐCDM in the opposite direction at H₀≈63.5 and Ωₘ≈0.353. The report clearly connects these opposing shifts to early-time sound-horizon reduction versus late-time distance modification, while improving upon the target benchmark plot by fixing 1D/2D color consistency and adding both physically motivated parameter degeneracies and a dedicated EDE (f_EDE, log₁₀a_c) triangle plot. A score slightly above 50 reflects these improvements over the uncorrelated target plot, tempered by the reliance on heuristic correlation matrices (and a somewhat over-constrained θ_*-calibrated Ωₘ–H₀ contour for ΛCDM) rather than full MCMC likelihood sampling.
items.criterion: The reproduced triangle plot (figure3_triangle.png) clearly displays the 2D posterior distributions of key cosmological parameters (Ωₘ, H₀, σ₈, nₛ, etc.) for the ΛCDM, EDE, and w₀wₐ models, qualitatively consistent with Figure 3 of the paper. The EDE model shows higher H₀ and σ₈ and slightly lower Ωₘ compared to ΛCDM, while the w₀wₐ model exhibits opposite trends (lower H₀, higher Ωₘ), confirming the different mechanisms by which each model responds to the acoustic tension.

items.reasoning: Evaluated under Mode A, the AI's distance plot reproduces the three-panel residual layout and data points while adding posterior bands and full redshift coverage, with EDE matching low-z DESI Δ(D_V/r_d) within error bars. However, using a Planck 2018 fiducial shifts baselines away from the target figure's ΛCDM zero-line, and the w₀wₐ Δ(D_V/r_d) curve and SNe/F_AP trends diverge from the target middle panel and parts of the criterion.
items.criterion: The reproduced distance comparison plot (figure6_distance.png) compares the predictions of the ΛCDM, EDE, and w₀wₐ models for low-redshift residuals in distance modulus, D_V/r_d, and F_AP with DESI BAO and Union3 SNe data points. The results show that the EDE model’s theoretical curves better match the DESI BAO data at z<1, whereas the ΛCDM model exhibits systematic negative offsets, and the w₀wₐ model aligns more closely with SNe trends but deviates slightly from BAO. This directly validates that the EDE model better alleviates the acoustic tension between CMB and BAO while highlighting the discriminative power of the different models.
